*F-OLE* (Oblivious linear evaluation) is part of *Oblivious Transfer and Correlated Randomness* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: an emerging formulation, still an active area of research.

*References:*

- Ghosh, Nielsen, and Nilges. [*Maliciously secure oblivious linear function evaluation with constant overhead*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2017/409). In Advances in Cryptology – ASIACRYPT 2017, 2017.
- Boyle et al. [*Compressing vector OLE*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2019/273). In ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS), 2018.
